rules.statement: Pass all Kestrel HTTPS defaults (protocol versions, cipher suite policy, client certificate settings) in a single `ConfigureHttpsDefaults` action, never in several calls.
rules.why: Kestrel keeps only the last action passed to `ConfigureHttpsDefaults`, so a second call silently discards the settings made by the first.
rules.check: Look for more than one `ConfigureHttpsDefaults` call on the same Kestrel options, or a new HTTPS setting added through a separate call instead of the existing shared configure method.

rules.statement: Set the server's `SslProtocols` explicitly to `SslProtocols.Tls12 | SslProtocols.Tls13` on every platform, and never enable `Tls`, `Tls11` or leave it to the operating system default.
rules.why: RFC 8996 deprecates TLS 1.0 and 1.1, and OS defaults vary between releases and deployments, which fails FAPI 1.0 Part 2 §8.5 and the conformance suite.
rules.check: Look for HTTPS configuration that omits `SslProtocols`, uses `SslProtocols.None`/`Default`, or includes `Tls`/`Tls11`.

rules.statement: Restrict TLS cipher suites through `CipherSuitesPolicy` only to AEAD suites with forward secrecy (TLS 1.3 AES-GCM and ECDHE ECDSA/RSA AES-GCM), and apply the policy only where the platform supports it (Linux and macOS), setting no policy on Windows.
rules.why: FAPI 1.0 Part 2 §8.5 permits only AEAD suites with forward secrecy, and `CipherSuitesPolicy` is not supported on Windows, where SChannel takes cipher suites from system configuration.
rules.check: Look for a `CipherSuitesPolicy` that lists non-AEAD or non-ECDHE suites (CBC, RSA key exchange), or that is set without a platform guard so it would throw on Windows.

rules.statement: Don't make TLS handshake settings (protocol versions, cipher suites) depend on the tenant or its security profile; apply them host-wide.
rules.why: The handshake happens before the request is read, so the host can't know which tenant the connection serves.
rules.check: Look for TLS or `SslServerAuthenticationOptions` configuration that reads tenant or per-request settings.
